adopted_plan.trust: Exact Source containing this fixed reference requires separate Owner acceptance. M1 integrity, authority labels or this candidate do not prove Native personal approval.

subject.targets_and_six_resources: Unchanged exact immutable plan; canonical resource order used by the existing Grant writer

prerequisite.qualification: Exact function owner, SECURITY DEFINER, empty search_path and private EXECUTE ACL unchanged before and after forward patch

LIVE.predicate: old.granted_at <= server_now AND old.expires_at > server_now + interval '1 hour'

GAP.predicate: server_now < old.expires_at AND old.expires_at <= server_now + interval '1 hour'

EXPIRED.scope: Only original approved_once, unused, nonrevoked, non-auto-approved Grant with verified original Native history and fixed adopted scope

private_scope_guards: Source-pinned exact adoption id/version/full M1 content hash/Receipt/Event/plan SHA; no title, label, latest or caller-selected replacement
Complete M1 integrity proof in private snapshot; not Native Owner attestation
Unique current non-race ACTIVE legal claim, current fence/lease, all three targets covered
Actual current Binding derived from the legal claim and privately compared with the approved business grantee reference
Exact Task version/full content, Global plus Project CURRENT, v12 actual permissions and revocation revalidation
Exact original request/key/action/resources/plan and original Native session/token/digest/Receipt chain
Scope resources exactly six, unique and equal as canonical sets; original Grant/plan are never rewritten
Missing, changed, revoked or mismatched source or scope is HOLD

native_interface.confirmation: Existing original writer with confirmation_token and view_digest only
native_interface.token: Fresh separate Native issue transaction, five-minute TTL, account session and exact view digest bound

expired_public_shape.scope_proof: Private only; public view exposes no new private Actor or Owner payload

native_interface.ui: Owner explicitly confirms the fresh expired authorization; unknown/partial/refused shape remains HOLD; no replacement request/key advice
native_interface.success_deadline: Display the actual writer-returned expires_at; no promise of a complete hour after COMMIT or response

transaction_and_replay.pre_write: Recompute exact context and private snapshot under existing locks before first Grant or Receipt write
transaction_and_replay.atomic: Original writer creates new Grant/Receipt, revokes old Grant, CAS-updates original request pointer and consumes the fresh token in one transaction
transaction_and_replay.preserved_history: Original request identity/Binding/key/plan, old granted_at/expires_at/uses and original Native token/Receipt unchanged except approved revocation and successor pointer fields
transaction_and_replay.failure: Roll back Grant/revoke/pointer together, preserving existing rejected-token burn and audit protocol
transaction_and_replay.replay: Same committed token returns same Grant/Receipt/deadline, never renews time or creates a second Grant
transaction_and_replay.unknown_result: Query the original confirmation token/digest; never issue replacement tokens to guess completion

required_qualification: Independent exact Source and affected Role/contract acceptance
Protected admission, current complete primary CI and actual critical steps
Exact separately approved forward SQL and Native UI publication with real backup/installation evidence
Fresh current scope and Owner personally confirmed Native view
Original unchanged-key Bootstrap commit considered only after its own actual current Grant and gates
exclusions: Automatic renewal or extension of the expired original Grant
Bootstrap, Canonical model projections, DomainAuthority, DataGate or M2 from Source installation
Model/data/training/device/paid or old terminal experiment/VM authorization
Full product qualification, activation or M7 completion from this successor
